about.lead: I am an AI Engineer and end-to-end builder who takes intelligent software from concept to production.
paragraphs: I believe impactful AI requires end-to-end mastery: from foundational machine learning and agentic reasoning to robust backend microservices, asynchronous architectures, and cloud deployments.

Rather than treating modeling and engineering as separate disciplines, I build complete systems: designing custom intelligence workflows, structuring scalable data pipelines, and deploying production services that operate reliably in the real world.

skills.title: Applied AI & Machine Learning
skills.description: Building classical machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, and experimental diagnostic models—from preprocessing and validation to production integration.

skills.title: LLMs & Multi-Agent Systems
skills.description: Developing production-grade LLM applications including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), autonomous multi-agent orchestration, and real-time inference pipelines.

skills.title: Backend Engineering & Cloud
skills.description: Architecting high-concurrency microservices, REST APIs, asynchronous task workers, database schemas, and containerized cloud deployments on AWS.

skills.title: Business & Product Strategy
skills.description: Bridging technology with commercial viability: customer retention intelligence, churn risk prediction, usage telemetry metering, and go-to-market execution.

timeline.title: AI Engineer (R&D) • Kamal-Paterson Ltd | KPCloud
